meta.title: Egg Fried Rice Three Ways (Pro Burner, Home Range, and Wok-Free) | Kenji's Cooking Show
meta.description:
Full printed recipes plus some links to more fried rice technique here:  https://www.seriouseats.com/recipes/2020/08/perfect-egg-fried-rice.html 

Jump to specific instructions:

On a wok burner, with wok at 1:21: https://youtu.be/u2MJzEuI0vI?t=72
On a home gas range, with wok at 4:54: https://youtu.be/u2MJzEuI0vI?t=294
On a home electric range, no wok at 6:09: https://youtu.be/u2MJzEuI0vI?t=609

I’m in the midst of testing outdoor wok burners, which means lots of fried rice with smoky wok hei. Here's how to make great fried rice no matter what kind of equipment you've got. Even better: It's only five ingredients.
